sources.title: AgentBox README
sources.locator: How it works; Install; Cloud Providers; How to use
sources.finding: CLI that launches coding agents into isolated local Docker or cloud VMs with checkpoints, a dashboard and a tray app; macOS or Linux with Docker; MIT.

sources.title: MIT License
sources.finding: MIT License, copyright 2026 Marco D'Alia.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 582 stars, MIT, pushed 2026-11-11, created 2026-05-12, homepage agent-box.sh.

sources.title: npm @madarco/agentbox
sources.finding: Latest 0.33.0 published 2026-09-21; nightly dist-tag 0.33.0-nightly.202609201432.

sources.title: AgentBox tray release
sources.finding: tray-latest (2026-09-21): AgentBox.dmg and AgentBox.zip with checksums and version.json; no Windows or Linux tray build.

sources.title: Architecture
sources.locator: Goal; Filesystem layout; Pause strategy; Lifecycle
sources.finding: Isolated boxes per agent run; Docker is the default backend with a git worktree on branch agentbox/<name> in the container; boxes pause and unpause; cloud backends compose the same supervisor and relay.

sources.title: Project context
sources.finding: Seven-plus provider backends behind one Provider interface; one agent per box; in-box supervisor agentbox-ctl; host relay for git push and other host-only actions; checkpoints per provider.

sources.title: Core concepts
sources.finding: A box per agent run with passwordless sudo and no access to host files, keys or network; parallel boxes; checkpoints; local or cloud with the same command; git push and PRs only after explicit approval.

sources.title: Run an agent
sources.locator: Launch an agent; First-run auth; Share a login; Add an agent
sources.finding: agentbox claude, codex, opencode and pi launch agents in detachable tmux sessions; credentials handled on the host and seeded into boxes; custom agents arrive as npm packages through agentbox agent add.

sources.title: Background and parallel
sources.locator: Queue background runs; Orchestrate boxes from an agent; Approve what a box is blocked on
sources.finding: -i queues background runs in a host-wide FIFO capped by queue.maxConcurrent; an installed skill and agentbox drive, agent and queue let an agent run a fleet; blocked prompts can be listed and answered.

sources.title: Hub web UI
sources.locator: What's in it; Running it for a team
sources.finding: Local dashboard served by the host relay at agentbox.localhost with box lifecycle controls, approvals inbox and box detail; the same app can deploy as a shared multi-user control plane with password login on Vercel or a VPS.

sources.title: Hub README
sources.locator: Endpoints; Public REST API; Profiles + auth
sources.finding: Next.js hub with relay core, GitHub App token leasing, approvals in Postgres, versioned /api/v1 REST API with OpenAPI, token or password auth profiles for localhost, hetzner and vercel.

sources.title: Deployed hub
sources.finding: Deploy the hub to a Hetzner VPS, DigitalOcean or Vercel so cloud boxes keep running and the registry is reachable with the laptop off.

sources.title: Sync and git
sources.locator: Push & pull via the relay; How the push reaches GitHub
sources.finding: Box git push, fetch, pull and gh pr operations go through a host relay with approval prompts; credentials stay on the host; download, upload, clone, back up and bring back a box.

sources.title: Checkpoints and pausing
sources.finding: Checkpoints snapshot a box so new boxes start warm; idle boxes pause; resume is sub-second on Docker.

sources.title: Configuration
sources.finding: Layered config with queue, idle and timeout keys per provider and a persistent box option.

sources.title: REST API
sources.finding: Documented versioned /api/v1 REST API with bearer token auth.

sources.title: CLI reference
sources.finding: Full command reference: create, claude, codex, opencode, pi, attach, drive, agent, queue, tasks, workspace, manager, checkpoint, hub and more.

sources.title: Local Docker
sources.finding: Default local backend running one Docker container per box.

sources.title: Remote Docker
sources.finding: Run boxes on a machine you already own over SSH with your own ssh config.

sources.title: Skills
sources.finding: AgentBox installs host skills so a host agent can drive the CLI.

sources.title: agentbox tasks
sources.finding: Workspace task list with statuses todo, in_progress, blocked and done, priority order, assign to a box, finish, update and delete, used by the human and the manager agent.

sources.title: agentbox workspace
sources.finding: Workspaces group projects and own a task list and manager sessions, stored on the hub.

sources.title: agentbox manager
sources.finding: A manager is the claude or codex session that creates and watches boxes; the hub can run one in a detached tmux session.

sources.title: Workspaces, tasks and manager plan
sources.finding: Phases 1-3, 5, 8a, 9a and 11a done; manager brief, hub UI for tasks, Linear import, tray plan and timeline views planned or in progress.

sources.title: Host relay package
sources.finding: Host process that boxes call for git push, checkpoint capture, file copy and status events; keeps SSH keys out of the box.

sources.title: Queue command
sources.finding: Host-wide FIFO queue for background -i runs.

sources.title: Agent registry
sources.finding: Built-in agent specs for claude, codex, opencode and pi plus openclaw as a service agent and a plugin path.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.finding: Pre-1.0; only the latest npm release gets security fixes; private reporting.
